source: Written 2026-10-11 from the verified oracle text (deck-verify runs 38162140013 and 38184868187) and this deck's notes; rewritten the same day for the $100-per-card list. Cards a caption names are [[bracketed]] so clips.py checks them against the current list. Opponents' cards are placeholders, never named.

scenes.head: Tergrid — Iron Fortress
scenes.sub: What your opponents sacrifice or discard becomes yours.

scenes.head: Her trigger
scenes.sub: Whenever an opponent sacrifices a nontoken permanent or discards a permanent card, you may put that card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.

scenes.head: Make them sacrifice…
scenes.sub: [[Sheoldred's Edict]], nontoken mode: each opponent sacrifices a nontoken creature.
scenes.say: Make them sacrifice. [[Sheoldred's Edict]], in its nontoken mode: each opponent sacrifices a nontoken creature.

scenes.head: …and Tergrid takes it.
scenes.sub: It comes onto the battlefield under your control.

scenes.head: Discard works too
scenes.sub: [[Thoughtseize]]: they reveal their hand and you choose a nonland card to discard.

scenes.head: Every permanent card they lose is yours.
scenes.sub: Pick the artifact. Tergrid puts it onto your battlefield.

scenes.head: Land her early. Keep her there. Feed her.
scenes.sub: Three clips follow, one for each.

scenes.head: Fast mana, every card under $100
scenes.sub: [[Sol Ring]], [[Mana Vault]], [[Lotus Petal]], [[Dark Ritual]] and [[Cabal Ritual]] start fast; [[Basalt Monolith]] and [[Mind Stone]] keep the mana coming.
scenes.say: Fast mana, with every card under a hundred dollars. [[Sol Ring]], [[Mana Vault]], [[Lotus Petal]], [[Dark Ritual]] and [[Cabal Ritual]] start fast. [[Basalt Monolith]] and [[Mind Stone]] keep the mana coming.

scenes.head: A turn-one Tergrid
scenes.sub: Turn 1: play a Swamp.

scenes.head: Dark Ritual
scenes.sub: Tap the Swamp for {B} and cast [[Dark Ritual]]: add {B}{B}{B}.
scenes.say: Tap the Swamp for one black mana and cast [[Dark Ritual]]. It adds three black.

scenes.head: Mana Vault
scenes.sub: Pay {1} of that for [[Mana Vault]], then tap it: add {C}{C}{C}.
scenes.say: Spend one of that mana on [[Mana Vault]], then tap the Vault for three colorless.

scenes.head: {3}{B}{B} — exactly her cost
scenes.sub: Two black and three colorless.
scenes.say: Two black and three colorless. That's exactly what she costs.

scenes.head: Tergrid on turn one
scenes.sub: It takes the right hand — that's what the tutors are for.

scenes.head: Six tutors find the missing piece
scenes.sub: [[Demonic Tutor]], [[Vampiric Tutor]], [[Insatiable Avarice]], [[Grim Tutor]], [[Diabolic Intent]], [[Beseech the Mirror]].

scenes.head: Insatiable Avarice: both modes
scenes.sub: Pay {B}, {2} and {B}{B}: put any card on top, then draw three — that card and two more. You lose 3 life.
scenes.say: [[Insatiable Avarice]], both modes. Pay five: put any card on top of your library, then draw three. That card, and two more. You lose three life.

scenes.head: Mulligan rule
scenes.sub: Mulligan hands that can't cast her by turn 3 and have no tutor.

scenes.head: Cast her through counterspells
scenes.sub: [[Cavern of Souls]] naming God makes her uncounterable. [[Defense Grid]] makes their spells cost {3} more during your turn.
scenes.say: [[Cavern of Souls]], naming God, makes her uncounterable. [[Defense Grid]] makes their spells cost three more during your turn.

scenes.head: Suit up
scenes.sub: [[Commander's Plate]]: protection from white, blue, red and green. [[Champion's Helm]] and [[Swiftfoot Boots]]: hexproof.

scenes.head: A wrath is coming…
scenes.sub: Destroy all creatures.

scenes.head: …flash in Mithril Coat
scenes.sub: [[Mithril Coat]] has flash, attaches to her as it enters, and makes her indestructible.

scenes.head: Exiled? She comes back.
scenes.sub: [[Kaya's Ghostform]] returns her if she dies or is put into exile.

scenes.head: Five more ways back
scenes.sub: [[Feign Death]], [[Undying Evil]], [[Not Dead After All]], [[Demonic Gifts]], [[Malakir Rebirth]].

scenes.head: The hole: edicts
scenes.sub: Hexproof and indestructible don't stop an edict. [[Black Market Connections]] can make a 3/2 token on each of your turns to sacrifice instead.
scenes.say: The hole in the fortress is edicts: hexproof and indestructible don't stop one. [[Black Market Connections]] can make a three-two token on each of your turns, to sacrifice instead. It costs you three life.

scenes.head: Trap: Toxic Deluge
scenes.sub: It's −X/−X, so indestructible won't save her. Cast [[Toxic Deluge]] before she lands, or keep X at 4 or less.
scenes.say: Trap: [[Toxic Deluge]] gives minus X minus X, so indestructible won't save her. Cast it before she lands, or keep X at four or less.

scenes.head: Why no Lightning Greaves?
scenes.sub: Shroud would stop your own [[Mithril Coat]] and [[Kaya's Ghostform]] from targeting her.

scenes.head: Strip their hand
scenes.sub: [[Grief]], [[Thoughtseize]], [[Unmask]], [[Duress]], [[Hymn to Tourach]], [[Mind Twist]]. Grief and Unmask can cost no mana at all.

scenes.head: Make it repeat
scenes.sub: [[The Raven Man]], [[Necrogen Mists]], [[Bottomless Pit]], [[Liliana of the Veil]], [[Rankle, Master of Pranks|Rankle]]. Most hit you too, so empty your hand first.

scenes.head: Get paid for every discard
scenes.sub: [[Geth's Grimoire]]: whenever an opponent discards a card, you may draw a card.

scenes.head: Edicts — after she lands
scenes.sub: [[Flare of Malice]] and [[Soul Shatter]] take each opponent's highest-mana-value creature or planeswalker. [[Sheoldred's Edict]] takes a nontoken one.

scenes.head: [[Braids, Cabal Minion]]
scenes.sub: Each upkeep, that player sacrifices an artifact, creature or land. Their nontoken ones are Tergrid's.

scenes.head: The two-card kill
scenes.sub: [[Exquisite Blood]] + [[Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose]]: their life loss gains you life, and your life gain drains them — until the table is dead.

cards.name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

scenes.head: The long way
scenes.sub: [[Torment of Hailfire]] off [[Cabal Coffers]] and [[Cabal Stronghold]] mana, [[Gray Merchant of Asphodel]], [[Phyrexian Obliterator]].

scenes.head: Tergrid — Iron Fortress
scenes.sub: Bracket 4 · option 1 of 3 · every card under $100 · the full plan is in the Plan tab.
scenes.say: Tergrid, Iron Fortress. Bracket four, with every card under a hundred dollars. The full plan is in the Plan tab.
